node.label: Abnormal mast cell morphology
node.definition: Any structural anomaly of mast cells, which are found in almost all tissues and contain numerous basophilic granules and are capable of releasing large amounts of histamine and heparin upon activation.

evidence.snippet: Aggressive systemic mastocytosis: Abnormal mast cell morphology (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
Abnormal mast cell morphology — Very frequent (99-80%)
